title: BeginnerLoginNotes
description: A small note-taking API where users can register, log in, create short private notes, list their own notes, and fetch one note by id.
generation_notes: Keep the workflow simple and deterministic: register, login, create note, list notes, get note.
Credentials must be created through the API; do not require pre-shared users.
The scenario should naturally exercise authentication and per-user ownership.
